span.span:
User Request:
"I would like to sell customizable cashmere coats for women. The price range would be in between $999 CAD and $1,199 CAD. Customers can choose from 10 colours; we customize based on the customer’s measurements. We plan to sell to U.S., Canadian, and UK customers. Our primary platform would be Etsy. These coats are made using a premium cashmere-wool blend, with cashmere taking 50% or more of the fabric content. The coats are handmade. We can also slightly adjust the style (add pockets, belts, etc.). We want to start small. For the first year, a $10,000 sale would be desirable. Could you analyze the market to see if there is an opening?"
